name: applypilot
description: Apply assigned jobs through Chrome using user-scoped ApplyPilot queue and profile tools.

interface.shortDescription: Work through your assigned application queue
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to a short-lived, user-scoped ApplyPilot run so it can read assigned jobs, retrieve grounded candidate facts when autofill misses a field, and record application outcomes.
defaultPrompt: Apply to my assigned ApplyPilot jobs.
